'''Osseous''' is the skeletal rex matriarch, one of the four [[Rex Matriarchs]]. Osseous is weak to [[necromancy]] and highly resistant to all remaining styles.

Unlike the other Rex Matriarchs, the quest [[Osseous Rex]] must be completed to fight Osseous inside the Rex Matriarch lair, requiring levels 70 Necromancy and 30 [[Archaeology]]. Osseous is also stronger than the other matriarchs, having nearly double their health, and has more damaging attacks and abilities. Her section of the arena is additionally cut off from the rest of the matriarchs; rather than entering the main arena from the [[Crumbled wall (Rex Matriarch lair)|crumbled wall]], players utilise a teleport crystal in the "lobby" to reach her.

Osseous' [[collection log]] is separate from that of the other matriarchs; while she retains all of the [[savage spear]] component drops, she does not have a corresponding combat heart, instead dropping the whole [[occultist's ring]]. She also drops [[jail cell key]]s used to unlock pet versions of three rex dinosaur variants.

Obtaining all of the drops from this encounter completes the achievement [[Ossy Ossy Ossy!]], unlocking the title {{TitleAnchor|the Skeletal}}.

===Getting there===
[[File:Rex Matriarchs Path.png|right|thumb|Directions to the Rex Matriarchs arena entrance from the [[Anachronia lodestone]]]]
[[File:Rex Matriarchs entrance teleportation device.png|thumb|Activating the device teleports the player to the dungeon beneath Anachronia, containing the matriarchs.]]

* By activating the [[Orthen teleportation device]] in the [[Spirit grove]], directly east from the [[Anachronia base camp]], then running all the way east until arriving at the [[Matriarch lair]] door.
* By using a War's retreat attuned [[Boss portal (War's Retreat)|boss portal]], being teleported right in front of the Rex Matriarch lair door.
* By using the [[Combat portal]] in the [[Max Guild]] and attuning it to the [[Rex Matriarchs]].

Activate the [[Osseous teleportation device]] inside the [[Rex Matriarch lair]], just west of the [[crumbled wall (Rex Matriarch lair)|crumbled wall]], to reach Osseous.

==Trivia==
* The name 'Osseous' refers to consisting of bones or turning into bone.
* The [[RuneMetrics]] Event Log incorrectly states drops that are received as {{RSFont|After killing a{{sic}} Osseous, it dropped a[n] [item].}}. Additionally, if the item is an [[occultist's ring]], the 's' at the end of 'occultist's' is clipped.
* Osseous was originally conceived during the [[Game Jam (June 2023)|June 2023]] [[Game Jam]] by a team consisting of [[Mod Camel]], [[Mod Abe]] and [[Mod Rain]], with other Moderators joining to provide support during subsequent Game Jams.
